integrity: One all-size theorem with the explicit 3-bar proof and independent small finite-field checks. Earlier finite simplex tables are acknowledged; independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Primitive cube root and complex coefficients; only complete transitive tournaments and the deleted extreme arc, with n>=4 for deletion. No claims on other roots, other edge deletions, or directed homotopy invariance.
title: Cubic Mayer path homology and extremal-edge stability of transitive tournaments
